state-offline.alt: A cloud crossed out beside a phone that shows a saved tick
state-offline.purpose: Offline banner and screens; reassures that nothing is lost

state-error.alt: A card with a red cross, standing for a failed action
state-error.purpose: Failed-state screens; always paired with the word Failed and what happens next

state-not-found.alt: A page with dashed lines and a magnifying glass showing a question mark

state-no-results.alt: A list of empty rows and a magnifying glass with a minus

state-success.alt: A large green circle with a tick and small confetti
state-success.purpose: Confirmed screens; used only after the provider confirms

state-maintenance.alt: A gear above a progress bar

state-sync-pending.alt: A cloud with an up arrow, a queue of items and a clock
state-sync-pending.purpose: Sync queue screens; shown with the word Queued or Sent

state-coming-soon.alt: A globe with a dashed ring and a map pin
state-coming-soon.purpose: Coming to your country soon: a regulated service waits for its licensed partner (for example cards before an issuer is signed)

onboarding-offline.alt: A phone that has saved a sale with a tick, beside a crossed-out wifi signal
onboarding-offline.purpose: Onboarding step 1: you can sell without internet

onboarding-chain.alt: Three linked blocks under a padlock, standing for a protected record of every sale
onboarding-chain.purpose: Onboarding step 2: every sale is saved in a protected chain

onboarding-provider.alt: A coin moving through a shield with a tick towards a bank building
onboarding-provider.purpose: Onboarding step 3: money moves through your licensed provider

onboarding-growth.alt: A storefront with an awning, a coin and an upward arrow
onboarding-growth.purpose: Onboarding step 4: see your business grow

agent-point.alt: A shop counter with cash notes and a phone showing a tick, joined by a dashed line to a partner building
agent-point.purpose: Agent point home: the agent serves customers with their own cash, and the licensed partner confirms every transaction before cash changes hands

chart-pricing-ladder.alt: Bar chart of the standard monthly price in US dollars for the Plus, Pro and Max tiers of each product family.
chart-pricing-ladder.purpose: Pricing page and investor material; numbers come from services/billing.py

chart-revenue-path.alt: Column chart of modelled monthly revenue at each growth stage on a logarithmic scale; an assumption, not a forecast.
chart-revenue-path.purpose: Blueprint and investor material; numbers come from finance/revenue_model.py

diagram-sync-states.alt: Diagram of a sale moving from the device through an optional relay to the cloud and the provider, with the five states.
diagram-sync-states.purpose: Help centre and onboarding: explains queued, sent, accepted, confirmed, failed

share-card.alt: LynkOmni logo beside a hub connected to seven small tiles.
share-card.purpose: Link-preview image for the website and shared links (surface share-image)

store-feature-graphic.alt: LynkOmni logo with a phone that has saved a sale and a cash register.

app-icon.alt: LynkOmni emblem on a plain background.

web-icons.alt: LynkOmni emblem on a plain background, in the sizes browsers and phones need.
web-icons.purpose: PWA install icons, favicon and touch icon (surface pwa-manifest)

vcard-edge.alt: Aurora Teal LynkVCard for the Free tier: deep teal rising to lagoon green with soft aurora waves, a silver chip, one point of mint light, the LynkOmni logo and the line EDGE // FIRST LIGHT. No number is drawn.
vcard-edge.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Free tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-hub.alt: Royal Sapphire LynkVCard for the Plus tier: midnight to royal blue with a fine guilloche pattern, a silver chip, a silver hub with three nodes, the LynkOmni logo and the line HUB // CENTER POINT. No number is drawn.
vcard-hub.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Plus tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-core.alt: Imperial Amethyst LynkVCard for the Pro tier: deep violet rising to brand violet with guilloche and a holographic band, a gold chip, a glowing magenta core inside its spend gauge, the LynkOmni logo and the line CORE // DEEP SYSTEM. No number is drawn.
vcard-core.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Pro tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-omni.alt: Black Gold LynkVCard for the Max tier: pure black with gold pinstripes and a gold foil edge, a gold chip, a gold globe with an orbit, the LynkOmni logo and the line OMNI // OWN ALL COMMERCE in gold. No number is drawn.
vcard-omni.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Max tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

diagram-vcard-tiers.alt: Diagram of the four LynkVCard tiers from left to right: Free with an Aurora Teal EDGE card, Plus with a Royal Sapphire HUB card, Pro with an Imperial Amethyst CORE card and Max with a Black Gold OMNI card, each with its price, number of cards, monthly spend limit, users and main feature.
diagram-vcard-tiers.purpose: Pricing page and help centre: what each card tier gives; every number comes from services/billing.py

vcard-edge-back.alt: Back of the Aurora Teal EDGE LynkVCard: a dark stripe, a calm panel where the issuer shows the card details, the point of light as a faint watermark, the LynkOmni logo and the word EDGE. No number is drawn.
vcard-edge-back.purpose: Back of the Free LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-hub-back.alt: Back of the Royal Sapphire HUB LynkVCard: a dark stripe, a calm panel where the issuer shows the card details, the hub as a faint watermark, the LynkOmni logo and the word HUB. No number is drawn.
vcard-hub-back.purpose: Back of the Plus LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-core-back.alt: Back of the Imperial Amethyst CORE LynkVCard: a dark stripe, a calm panel where the issuer shows the card details, the core as a faint watermark, the LynkOmni logo and the word CORE. No number is drawn.
vcard-core-back.purpose: Back of the Pro LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-omni-back.alt: Back of the Black Gold OMNI LynkVCard: a dark stripe, a calm panel where the issuer shows the card details, the globe as a faint gold watermark, the LynkOmni logo and the word OMNI in gold. No number or bank name is drawn.
vcard-omni-back.purpose: Back of the Max LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-core-near-limit.alt: The Imperial Amethyst CORE LynkVCard near its spend limit: an amber gauge almost full with a triangle marker and a diamond centre instead of a dot, so the warning does not rely on colour.
vcard-core-near-limit.purpose: CORE card state when spend is near the limit; uses shape and colour together

vcard-omni-physical.alt: The physical companion for the OMNI LynkVCard: a full metal Black Gold card with a gold chip, a gold globe and orbit, a gold foil edge, no number on the front and the line OMNI // OWN ALL COMMERCE.
vcard-omni-physical.purpose: Physical companion card for the Max tier (ordered through the issuer's fulfilment partner)
